sentences.text:
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/Section 439 of Cr.P.C., 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.177 of 2024 registered at Police Station Ari, District- Seoni (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366(A), 376(1) and 376(2)(N) of IPC and 3/4, 5(L)/6 and 5(J)
(ii) of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

At the date of incident, as per the prosecution itself, the victim was 17 years 9 months 16 days and the prosecution has based in the case of the scholar register in the statement recorded under Section 183 of BNS, 2023.
The victim has clearly stated that she with her own violation went with the applicant and both have married, they are residing as husband and wife.
As the age will be decided after trial, therefore, no case is made out.
Hence, the applicant is entitled to be NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6339 2 MCRC-4377-2025 released on bail.
3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and submitted that DNA report is positive and applicant is not entitled for bail.

4. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.
5.
Looking to the age of the victim and as trial will take time to conclude, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
